description: When a result says NEEDS A PERSON (a sign-in, a one-time code or 2FA, a device approval, a CAPTCHA), tell the user in your reply what the page needs and that the pilotfish browser window is open on it; when they have done it there (or right after asking), call this and carry on: it waits until the page has moved on, then returns it. BLOCKED and STOP mean the site cannot be continued that way.
name: browser_resume
title: Continue after the person
